claim: Under the compact H9/14 missing-face reductions, all five Dehn--Sommerville schedules for record 35 are exhaustive. Strict vertex-link positivity removes a=3,4; complete missing-four and forced-shadow censuses remove a=2 and leave one a=1 incidence orbit. A lossless all-cap-feasible-independent-active-row census leaves three a=0 incidence orbits passing the full necessary topology audit. Complete Lanner-placement joins reject all eighteen a=0 facet-count targets, while a monotonicity and exact-index-two gate rejects the a=1 orbit. Hence the whole graph shadow is not compact Coxeter.

independent_hostile_replay.complete_active_row_scope: all independent active subsets allowed by exact incidence caps; no singleton-row normalization

nonclaims: No finite-volume noncompact chamber is excluded.
No ideal-vertex or maximal-parabolic census is performed.
No other H9/14 graph shadow is excluded by this certificate.
The mod-two all-link homology audit is not a PL-sphere certificate and does not detect odd torsion or simple connectivity.
Arbitrary ordinary completions with minimal nonfaces above the compact Coxeter order bound are not classified.
proof_dependencies: Burcroff's no-missing-triples theorem for compact H9/14 nerves
every compact Coxeter missing face is Lanner of order at most five
Dehn--Sommerville equations for the simplicial polar boundary
strict generalized-lower-bound and Macaulay inequalities in every vertex link
facet complements are the blocker of the full minimal-nonface clutter
complete enumeration of every independent active row subset allowed by the exact incidence caps and exact isolate-column multiplicities
complete Lanner placement joins tested on all actual vertices
Perron--Frobenius monotonicity, Cauchy interlacing, and exact negative-index-two principal blocks

lossless_enumeration_scope.active_row_statement: all independent active subsets allowed by the exact incidence caps are admitted in every A5 row; rows are an unordered multiset. No singleton-active-row normalization is imposed
lossless_enumeration_scope.isolate_column_statement: the eight isolate columns are an exact multiplicity vector, hence a complete quotient by S8

a1_unrestricted_label_audit.coverage_argument: Every full locally elliptic state can be weakened by changing all but one cross edge to label 2 and the retained edge to label 3. Exactly 5,040 sparse states admit one such edge and no sparse state admits two. Labels 4 and 5 admit none. Every exceptional edge joins the R and B A5 supports, whose exact ten-node principal Gram has negative index two. Labels on the two internal unforced pairs involve facet 2 outside that principal block and cannot change its inertia
